notes.title: PIK 2.0 - Version Release
notes.content: [h2]Pure Instinct Katana Version 2 includes major new features:[/h2][p][u]Gameplay:[/u][/p][p]Default Player UI now includes a live character portrait that gives you real time view of the action next to your HP bar. [/p][p]The new UI layout also includes the pop-up bottom icon (B), a proc the player is granted for consecutive attacks, which, if hit in timing, will vary their combo with a special strike based on the elemental style currently used.[/p][p][u]Balancing:[/u][/p][p]Elemental Warrior: slightly increased elemental proc frequency, and enhanced knock-back after magical effect accumulation.[/p][p]Champion's Arena: Mecha-armor ability has been officially joined together with Skin Change ability, and a hidden fairy (no purchase required) has been added to the arena. [/p][p][u]Design:[/u][/p][p]Style effects enhancements: [/p][p]Lightning Lynx attacks now instantly spark lightning arcs. Visual enhancements to lightning textures on magic attacks.[/p][p]Fire Monkey attack trails enhanced in textures.[/p][p]Shadow Wolf attacks' trailing shadows emboldened.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Optimizations:[/u][/p][p]Reduced GPU and Memory consumption at runtime, and even faster level load ups.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: Players who already have a cached data may experience minor hitches at first launch. This can be fixed by a restarting the game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Pure Instinct Katana - Master's Arena (version 1.1)
notes.content:
Content additions:

1. An interactable book containing lore about the bosses has been added to Katana's house.
2. An unlockable door leading to Master's Arena has been added to Katana's house.
3. A new boss fight that unlocks a new transformation ability - Mecha-Armor.

Technical:
1. Added Auto-lock on enemies button.
2. Updated game engine to Unreal 5.6

Stylistic:
1. Camera field of view and positional offset adjusted.
2. Altered sprint animation and effect.
3. Pronounced slow-motion effects on parry and successful hits.
